question: In arc 3, chapter 80 “The End of Sloth”, Subaru and Julius were guessing that Petelgeuse was a spirit. Did they guess that “Julius already has a spirit contract, so he can’t be possessed”?
answer: Julius was confident, and Subaru felt sort of like “He’s a spirit arts user, he’ll probably manage somehow against a spirit.”. Julius didn’t express any concerns, so Subaru trusted him enough to not feel a need to ask. He wouldn’t admit to being friends with him, though.
